summary: isolation-vm can be signed on a machine with /dev/kvm: scripts/st-test --all (and --check isolation-vm) runs `nix develop -c bash scripts/ci-local isolation-vm`, which builds the workspace test archive and the production gateway in place and runs both VM drivers, as CI's isolation-vm job does; the policy admits host and agent notes for pull requests with that command, through a new lane. Skipping stays off (enforce false).

replay.detail: A new local command, lane and host/agent signer levels for one check; no protocol or schema change.

schema.detail: A new local command, lane and host/agent signer levels for one check; no protocol or schema change.

rules.detail: The isolation-vm wrapper kind now trusts host and agent notes for pull_request runs whose command is the new local lane's (by_level, lane: true); merge_group still runs it, and enforce stays false, so nothing skips yet.

compatibility.detail: A new local command, lane and host/agent signer levels for one check; no protocol or schema change.

downtime.detail: A new local command, lane and host/agent signer levels for one check; no protocol or schema change.

manual.detail: None. A machine that signs it needs /dev/kvm read-write for its user.

recovery.detail: Revert the policy and lane entries; CI keeps running and signing isolation-vm as before.
